mapper.select: SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, COUNT(rs.route_id) AS routeCount, s.cluster_id AS clusterId FROM station s LEFT JOIN route_station rs ON s.station_id = rs.station_id GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.lng, s.lat, s.cluster_id

SELECT DISTINCT r.route_id AS routeId, r.route_name AS routeName, r.is_up_or_down AS isUpOrDown FROM route r INNER JOIN route_station rs ON r.route_id = rs.route_id WHERE rs.station_id = #{stationId} ORDER BY r.route_name, r.is_up_or_down

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat FROM station s INNER JOIN route_station rs ON s.station_id = rs.station_id WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} AND s.station_id >= 1000 ORDER BY rs.id

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, ps.parking_count AS parkingCount FROM station_parking_summary ps INNER JOIN station s ON s.station_id = ps.station_id WHERE s.station_id >= 1000 ORDER BY ps.parking_count DESC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, ps.avg_duration_seconds AS avgDurationSeconds, ps.parking_count AS parkingCount FROM station_parking_summary ps INNER JOIN station s ON s.station_id = ps.station_id WHERE s.station_id >= 1000 AND ps.avg_duration_seconds > 0

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR(sp.start_date_time) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS morningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR(sp.start_date_time) BETWEEN 17 AND 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS eveningCount, SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR(sp.start_date_time) NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND HOUR(sp.start_date_time) NOT BETWEEN 17 AND 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offPeakCount, ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR(sp.start_date_time) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR(sp.start_date_time) BETWEEN 17 AND 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN HOUR(sp.start_date_time) NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 8 AND HOUR(sp.start_date_time) NOT BETWEEN 17 AND 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) AS peakRatio FROM station_parking sp INNER JOIN station s ON sp.station_id = s.station_id WHERE s.station_id >= 1000 GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name HAVING morningCount + eveningCount > 0 ORDER BY peakRatio DESC LIMIT #{topN}
SELECT HOUR(start_date_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM station_parking WHERE station_id = #{stationId} GROUP BY HOUR(start_date_time) ORDER BY hour

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.route_id) AS routeCount, COUNT(sp.id) AS parkingCount FROM station s INNER JOIN route_station rs ON s.station_id = rs.station_id LEFT JOIN station_parking sp ON s.station_id = sp.station_id WHERE s.station_id >= 1000 GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.lng, s.lat ORDER BY routeCount DESC, parkingCount DESC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, COUNT(DISTINCT sec.route_number) AS parkingCount FROM station s JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id AS sid, route_number FROM section UNION SELECT DISTINCT end_station_id, route_number FROM section ) sec ON sec.sid = s.station_id WHERE s.station_id >= 1000 GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.lng, s.lat ORDER BY parkingCount DESC

SELECT s.cluster_id AS clusterId, COUNT(DISTINCT agg.station_id) AS stationCount, AVG(agg.avg_duration_seconds) AS avgDurationSeconds, SUM(agg.parking_count) AS totalParkingCount FROM station_parking_summary agg INNER JOIN station s ON s.station_id = agg.station_id WHERE s.cluster_id IS NOT NULL AND s.station_id >= 1000 GROUP BY s.cluster_id ORDER BY avgDurationSeconds DESC

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, ps.avg_duration_seconds AS avgDurationSeconds, ps.parking_count AS parkingCount FROM station_parking_summary ps INNER JOIN station s ON s.station_id = ps.station_id WHERE s.station_id >= 1000 AND ps.avg_duration_seconds > 0 ORDER BY avgDurationSeconds DESC LIMIT #{topN}

SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.lng, s.lat, COALESCE(ps.avg_duration_seconds, 0) AS avgDuration FROM route_station rs INNER JOIN station s ON s.station_id = rs.station_id LEFT JOIN station_parking_summary ps ON ps.station_id = s.station_id WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} AND s.station_id >= 1000 ORDER BY rs.id
